catalog_source: complete exact Johnson-slice catalogs imported from the audited z=2 implementation

mean_leaf_coverage.high_definition: catalog_level=q+residue/4 >= 2; residue-zero q>=2 and residue-four q>=1

sieve_method.at_most_two_enumerated_catalogs: retain all and exact-join complete catalogs
sieve_method.high_blocks: annihilate the full 35-column direction block (a superset relaxation of the exact high catalog)
sieve_method.more_than_two_enumerated_catalogs: test every retained pair and annihilate every other variable direction block
sieve_method.rejection_semantics: one zero-hit necessary projection rigorously excludes the leaf
sieve_method.survivor_semantics: passed every planned projection; necessary mod-seven survivor only, not an edge lift
